rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an animal's hair or fur coat.

example.english: The cat has shed so much fur that it’s all over the house.
example.traditional: 隻貓甩咗好多毛，搞到成屋都係。
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 lat1 zo2 hou2 do1 mou4 gaau2 dou2 seng4 uk1 dou1 hai6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing fur as a thick pelt or material rather than individual hairs.

example.english: That fur pelt in the exhibition has been preserved very well.
example.traditional: 展覽入面嗰塊毛皮保存得好好。
example.jyutping: zin2 laam5 jap6 min6 go2 faai3 mou4 pei4 bou2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 hou2
